title: finding(app-shell): Studio's Interfaces rail keeps nav editing open after the package answers read-only, so edits are taken on screen and never saved
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` a public door, measured: the Studio Interfaces rail's Edit toggle.
- **The sequence.** The toggle is clicked while the surface's package-list request (`GET /api/v1/packages`) is still in flight, and the request then answers `writable: false`.
- **Measured.** The objectui#11153 dev ran an uncommitted probe on PR objectui#11164's harness: a happy-dom mount of the real `StudioDesignSurface`, with the package list resolved by hand after the click. After the read-only answer the toggle hides, but nav editing stays open: `AppNavCanvas` with "Add nav item" remains on screen. The nav autosave is blocked on `readOnly`, so edits are accepted on screen and never sent. The probe ran once, in happy-dom, not in a live browser.
- **Confirmed at source.** PR objectui#11164's contract review (`5902516373`, ③ out-of-scope (a)) confirmed it real at the head and pre-existing. It also found that PR objectui#11164 neither improves nor worsens it.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11164 (objectui#11153), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (`5902396944`). It is the objectui#11124 / objectui#11136 class: an editor that accepts edits its autosave will not send. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The site (read at PR objectui#11164's head `c262d51ee`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`; re-read by content after it lands)

- **The toggle** renders under `appStatus === 'ready' && !readOnly`. `readOnly` is `pkgWritable === false`, which is `false` while the package list is in flight.
- **`editNav` is turned off** only by the toggle's own `onClick`. Its other writer, the deep link's apply, only ever sets it to `true`.
- **The nav autosave** is `blocked: … || readOnly`.
- **The result.** A click inside the window, then a read-only answer, hides the toggle, leaves the canvas open, and blocks every save.

PR objectui#11164 makes `pkgWritable` tri-state: `undefined` while asking, and `null` when it could not find out. A fix can therefore tell "still asking" from "answered".

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- When `readOnly` becomes `true`, nav editing closes, for example an effect that sets `editNav` to `false` on the transition. Alternatively, the toggle is withheld until the write state settles.
  - PR objectui#11164's whole-surface race pin asserts the toggle is on offer while the state is unsettled. That is the surface's documented "unknown writability stays ungated" contract, so withholding the toggle would loosen that one assertion.
  - Closing on the transition keeps the contract.
- Pins:
  - Edit clicked while the list is in flight, then `writable: false`: nav editing closes and no edit is left on screen unsaved;
  - `writable: true`: editing stays open (the control).

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (down to #10338) were grepped:
- `pkgWritable` and `nav autosave`: only PR objectui#11164 (the source).
- `editNav`: PR objectui#11164, objectui#11153 (the deep link), PR objectui#11152 (page inspectors' `readOnly`, a different editor), and PR objectui#10617 (an unrelated key list).
- `Edit navigation`: 0 hits.

No card covers this.
